subject: Request: Exec sign-off for premium onboarding + custom integration (BlueBridge Labs)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@bluebridgelabs.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Premium onboarding + custom integration (SOW attached)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attached is the draft SOW and a pricing summary for the package we discussed: 6-week custom integration (data pipeline + SSO), priority 24/7 Premium Support for 12 months, and an onboarding services bundle.

Key commercial items in the draft:
- One-time engineering SOW: 6 weeks, estimated 480 engineer-hours
- Premium Support: included for first 12 months (24/7, 1-hour P1 SLA)
- Onboarding fee: listed but we have flexibility to waive for strategic pilots

BlueBridge is asking for two non-standard asks: (1) include the custom integration work in the committed price (instead of a separate time-and-materials SOW) and (2) waive the onboarding setup fee. They see this as a strategic enterprise pilot with potential to expand in 2027.

Could you review the attached and confirm next steps? Elena, if this looks roughly right, can we lock the commercial terms so I can push through procurement?

Attachments: [SOW_BlueBridge_CustomIntegration_v1.pdf (application/pdf)], [Pricing_Summary_BlueBridge.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Elena Rossi <elena@bluebridgelabs.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@bb-labs.com>, procurement@bluebridgelabs.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Premium onboarding + custom integration (SOW attached)

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for sending this over. Overall this looks aligned with our internal needs. Two things before procurement signs:
1) We need the custom integration work priced as a fixed line item (we can commit to a purchase order if it’s fixed).
2) Can you include the first 12 months of Premium Support in the initial contract (we prefer a single invoice/mechanism).

If you can accommodate those two items and confirm a small concession on onboarding (we were hoping to reduce the setup fee by at least 50%), procurement will move quickly.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Integrations, BlueBridge Labs
elena@bluebridgelabs.com
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: Premium onboarding + custom integration — exec approval requested

Team —

Looping you in. BlueBridge is pushing to have the custom integration and 12 months of Premium Support bundled into the contracted scope as fixed-price items and to reduce/waive the onboarding fee. Deal is estimated at $420k ARR (year 1 committed usage) with a $120k one-time professional fee if sold separately. If we accommodate the asks up front, the customer has signaled a strong chance to expand to multi-region deployment in Q1 2027.

I’ve prepared a short rationale (attached) recommending we:
- Include the 6-week custom integration as a fixed SOW line at $95k (discounted from $120k)
- Include Premium Support for 12 months at no additional recurring charge for the first year
- Waive the onboarding setup fee for the pilot

Requesting executive sign-off to proceed with these non-standard concessions. Rishi — can you confirm whether we can approve the one-time engineering discount and the waived onboarding fee for strategic pilots under the 6-figure ARR threshold?

Attachment: [Exec_Approval_Rationale.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, West
markus@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: Premium onboarding + custom integration — exec approval requested

Markus / team —

I reviewed the rationale. Given the likelihood of a multi-region expansion and the ARR profile you called out, I approve the concessions with the following conditions:
1) Fixed SOW line for integration capped at $95k and tied to milestone payments (20% on kickoff, 60% after integration demo, 20% on closeout).
2) Premium Support included for the first 12 months but revert to standard support pricing at renewal unless a renewal package is agreed.
3) Onboarding fee waived for this pilot only; include explicit language that waivers are not precedent-setting and require exec approval for future deals.
4) Legal to add a 90-day success review clause (we will bill remaining professional hours if scope creep is identified beyond the agreed SOW).

Markus — please finalize the SOW with these conditions and push the updated docu-sign link to procurement. Also add a short note in the HubSpot deal explaining the exec-approved one-off concessions.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@bluebridgelabs.com>, procurement@bluebridgelabs.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sign-off for premium onboarding + custom integration (BlueBridge Labs)

Elena / Tom / procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal review, we can proceed with the following commercial terms (approved by our CRO):
- Fixed-price integration SOW: $95,000 (milestone schedule included)
- Premium Support: included for 12 months at no additional recurring charge; standard pricing resumes at renewal
- Onboarding setup fee: waived for this pilot
- 90-day success review clause to validate scope; any confirmed scope creep will be handled per the SOW change order process

I’ve updated the SOW and sent the DocuSign link here: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/BBL-SOW-2026. The HubSpot deal (DEAL-2026-1934) will contain the exec approval note and approval artifact.

Attachments: [SOW_BlueBridge_CustomIntegration_v1.pdf], [Pricing_Summary_BlueBridge.xlsx]

Next steps for procurement: confirm PO and sign the DocuSign SOW so we can schedule the engineering kickoff.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, West
